name: Mechanics of Yarn Formation
description: Mechanics of opening and cleaning of fibre tuft; blending Eelay time; uniformity of mixing and blending; classical theory of carding operation; analysis of load on various sections of the cylinder; fibre transfer efficiency and its theoretical aspects; ideal drafting mechanics; geometrical analysis of fibre movement during drafting; drafting force in ideal drafting; mechanics of drafting wave generation; theory of draft distribution; nipping of sliver by rollers: roller eccentricity; roller slip; mechanics of hook removal in the draw frame; fractionation of fibres of the specified length and noil theory; detaching roller motion through epicyclic gear arrangement; winding on the roving bobbin and differential gear arrangement; cone-drum belt shifting; winding tension in flyer leading roving frames for jute/flax; forces acting on the traveller; spinning balloons and balloon tension; yarn tension in ring spinning; spinning geometry and spinning triangle; ring-traveller speed relationship and twist compensation; twist insertion and cyclic fibre aggregation in rotor spinning; mechanics of formation of friction-spun yarn structures; twist insertion in friction spinning.
